cands.bio: Benjamin W. Robbins is a Republican who has represented Alabama House District 33 since January 2021, after winning a special election. He is an attorney who runs a law practice in Sylacauga. He was a legislative correspondent for U.S. Sen. Richard Shelby from 2007 to 2008.
cands.gaps: We found no documented stated positions or specific actions by Ben Robbins on data centers, homestead taxes, land ownership, growth, immigration, policing, guns, abortion or school choice in the pages we could read. His birthplace and the year he moved, if he moved, are not stated. He did not complete Ballotpedia's candidate survey in 2020, 2022 or 2026. Ballotpedia lists no endorsements for him in 2026. Ballotpedia's sponsored-legislation section had no readable list, so we could not report any bills he sponsored. We found no controversies in the pages we read.
